question: In a ΔABC, O is the orthocenter of this triangle. ∠B = 55 degrees and ∠BOC = 120 degrees. What is the value of ∠ACB?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The angle at the **orthocenter** ∠BOC and the opposite vertex angle ∠A are **supplementary**.

∠A = 180° − ∠BOC = 180° − 120° = 60°.

In ΔABC, the sum of all angles is 180°.

∠ACB = 180° − (∠A + ∠B) = 180° − (60° + 55°) = 65°.

**∴ The correct answer is 65 degree.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In ΔABC, O is the **orthocenter**.

∠B = 55°

∠BOC = 120°

**Formula Used:**

1. Angle at orthocenter: ∠BOC = 180° − ∠A

2. Angle sum property: ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c01a2dd91ff40d267b9b234f1f5fff03df47af108f864150d8c598a18653bd24.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ ∠BOC = 180° − ∠A

⇒ 120° = 180° − ∠A

⇒ ∠A = 180° − 120° = 60°

⇒ In ΔABC, ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

⇒ 60° + 55° + ∠ACB = 180°

⇒ 115° + ∠ACB = 180°

⇒ ∠ACB = 180° − 115° = 65°

**∴ The correct answer is 65 degree.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Orthocenter Properties

The orthocenter is the intersection point of the altitudes. The angle subtended by any side at the orthocenter and the interior angle at the opposite vertex are supplementary (sum = 180°).

Orthocentric System

In any triangle ABC with orthocenter O, each of the four points (A, B, C, or O) is the orthocenter of the triangle formed by the other three points.

Euler Line

In a non-equilateral triangle, the orthocenter (O), centroid (G), and circumcenter (C) are collinear, with the centroid dividing the segment OC in the ratio 2 : 1.</p
